courses.subject: URES
courses.title: Undergraduate Research
courses.description: This course is for students who participate in not-for-credit-research experiences (e.g. volunteer activities or paid activities). Learning contract required. Students should contact the Office for Undergraduate Research for additional details.

courses.subject: URES
courses.title: Undergraduate Research
courses.description: This course is for students who participate in research under the direction of a mentor who is not UNC-Chapel Hill faculty during the academic year or while enrolled in Summer School. Learning contract required. Students should contact the Office for Undergraduate Research for additional details.
courses.repeat_rules: May be repeated for credit. 2 total credits. 2 total completions.

courses.subject: URES
courses.title: Undergraduate Research
courses.description: This course is for students who participate in research under the direction of a UNC-CH faculty mentor in an academic unit, institute, or center than cannot otherwise award them credit. Learning contract required. Students should contact the Office for Undergraduate Research for additional details.
courses.repeat_rules: May be repeated for credit. 6 total credits. 6 total completions.
